text: Blockchain removes the reconciliation problem in private equity administration by letting every party to a deal view a single compiled version of the transaction and its associated data, instead of reconciling multiple copies of deal documents.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2998033

isBasedOn.name: Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds

abstract: the blockchain program announced by Northern Trust and IBM allows all involved parties in an equity deal to look at a single compiled version of the transaction and all other data relating to the deal.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: illustrated by the February 2017 Northern Trust and IBM private equity administration partnership
